gizmo.title: Pātai Whakahāngai
gizmo.description: He ngohe whakahāngai tō-me-tuku e takirua ana i ngā kupu akiaki me ō rātou whakautu tika.

configure.title: Pātai
configure.description: Pātai mā ngā kaiwhakamahi. Tohua ngā whāinga tuku, kātahi ka whakarārangi i ngā whakautu tae noa ki te whāinga e whai ake ana.

advanced.title: Ka taea te hinga
advanced.description: Whakaatu i tēnei pātai hei rarangi ka whakatuwhera ka katia. Ka katia ētahi atu pātai ka taea te hinga e tata ana ina whakatuwheratia tētahi.

advanced.title: Tīmata ka hinga
advanced.description: Ina taea te hinga, tīmata hei rarangi kati e whakaatu ana i te pātai me tōna āhua anake.

advanced.title: Hōputu kōeke
advanced.description: OER Schema: hōputu kōeke mō tēnei aromatawai (hei tauira, piro, reta, ōrau, whakaotinga).

advanced.title: Whāinga ako
advanced.description: OER Schema: te whāinga ako e hono ana ki tēnei aromatawai.

developer.title: Ingoa o te pātaitai
developer.description: Ingoa pātaitai hei tautuhi xAPI i ngā pūnaha tātari.

developer.title: Akoranga
developer.description: OER Schema: te akoranga i hangaia ai tēnei aromatawai.
